summary: Kandal M Venture Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice of Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) and proxy statement for a share consolidation resolution. The proposal would consolidate every 16 issued and unissued ordinary shares (both Class A and Class B) into one share, reducing authorized shares from 5,000,000,000 to 312,500,000, with par value adjusted to US$0.00016. The EGM is scheduled for July 9, 2026, in Hong Kong. This is a routine corporate action to adjust share structure, likely to meet Nasdaq listing requirements. No special situation (merger, acquisition, activist, strategic review, etc.) is involved.
